newsitem.title: USA: El Paso Energy to issue $400 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: El Paso Energy to issue $400 mln in debt.

text.p: El Paso Energy Corp said it planned to issue $400 million in long-term debt as part of its recapitalization plan in anticipation of its merger with Tenneco Inc.
The company said in a statement it would issue the debt once its $800 million universal shelf registration on file with the Securities and Exchange Commission was declared effective.
El Paso energy filed for shelf registration on October 22.
Next month, shareholders are to vote on whether to accept the proposed merger of the two companies.

On November 4, Tenneco received favorable rulings from the Internal Revenue Service and the Securities and Exchange Commission on the merger, which would lead to the spin off of its Newport News Shipbuilding unit.
